prompt:

SURFACE: Rich natural tactile living materials appropriate to subject; wet scales, feather barbs, coarse woven cloth, tangled hair, cracked earth. No plastic.
SETTING: Swan/Canning river creation in southwestern Western Australia, sandy banks and sparse local vegetation. [wagyl-c01, wagyl-c02, wagyl-c12]
MOOD: Imposing dangerous menace or respectful reverent awe as appropriate to tradition. Living religion deities retain reverence. Never cute, calm, ordinary human/animal snapshot, static facing pose or decorative landscape. Subject dominates, action addresses viewer.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: Native squarePNG minimum1024. No text, lettering, glyphs, logo, border, frame or watermark. No extra heads, limbs, eyes, fingers or attributes. No design from films, games, anime or comics. Opaque clothing covers human chest and hips. No nudity or explicit gore. No generic glowing aura, neon outline, floating runes or energy ribbons; no invented powers. Exact sourced variant anatomy overrides associations.
